items.title: France drops its €100,000 self-custody reporting rule
items.excerpt: The rule went out when the National Assembly rejected the revenue section of the 2027 budget.

items.title: Moscow Exchange will list Bitcoin from 1 December
items.excerpt: ETH and USDT come too. Non-qualified retail investors get caps on how much they can buy.

items.title: FBI names North Korea's TraderTraitor behind the Binance heist
items.excerpt: The bureau asked the industry to block the addresses used to launder the stolen funds.

items.title: Tether's CEO says the firm holds about 150,000 BTC
items.excerpt: Its latest reserve report implies about 100,060. The two figures are from different dates, so read them carefully.
